mapper.select: SELECT ics01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, ics01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, ics01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code, ics01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, ics01_seq AS seq, ( SELECT STRING_AGG(f_get_deadline_nm(sch03_deadline_id, '2'), ', ') FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_info_id = ics01_class_tree_id ) AS deadline_full_name, NULL::int AS depth FROM ics01_class_tree WHERE ics01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics01_class_tree ( ics01_class_tree_id, ics01_parent_tree_id, ics01_class_tree_cd, ics01_class_tree_nm, ics01_seq, ics01_company_id, ics01_type_cd, ics01_use_yn, ics01_advis_yn ) VALUES ( #{classTreeId}, #{req.parentTreeId}, #{req.classTreeCode}, #{req.classTreeName}, #{req.seq}, #{companyId}, 'IC', 'true', 'false' )
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ics_down_tree( ics01_class_tree_id , ics01_company_id , ics01_parent_tree_id , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT ics01_class_tree_id , ics01_company_id , ics01_parent_tree_id , 1 , ARRAY[a.ics01_parent_tree_id || a.ics01_seq::text] , false FROM ics01_class_tree a WHERE ics01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} UNION ALL SELECT a.ics01_class_tree_id , a.ics01_company_id , a.ics01_parent_tree_id , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, a.ics01_parent_tree_id || a.ics01_seq::text) , a.ics01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM ics01_class_tree a INNER JOIN ics_down_tree b ON a.ics01_parent_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id WHERE NOT CYCLE ) SELECT ics01_class_tree_id FROM ics_down_tree
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics99_class_tree_del SELECT f_create_seq() , #{empId} , f_sysdate() , ics01_class_tree_id , ics01_parent_tree_id , ics01_class_tree_cd , ics01_class_tree_nm , ics01_seq , ics01_related_law , ics01_submit_to , ics01_company_id , ics01_type_cd , ics01_use_yn , ics01_content , ics01_public_type , ics01_advis_yn FROM ics01_class_tree WHERE ics01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE ics_tree_down( ics01_class_tree_id , ics01_parent_tree_id , ics01_class_tree_cd , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.ics01_class_tree_id , a.ics01_parent_tree_id , a.ics01_class_tree_cd , 0 , ARRAY[a.ics01_class_tree_cd::text] , false FROM ics01_class_tree a WHERE ics01_company_id in (#{companyId},0) AND ics01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} UNION ALL SELECT a.ics01_class_tree_id , a.ics01_parent_tree_id , a.ics01_class_tree_cd , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, a.ics01_class_tree_cd::text) , a.ics01_class_tree_cd = any(b.path) FROM ics01_class_tree a , ics_tree_down b WHERE a.ics01_parent_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id AND a.ics01_company_id in (#{companyId},0) AND not cycle ) SELECT a.ics01_class_tree_id FROM ics_tree_down a

ics01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, ics01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, ics01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code, ics01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, ics01_content AS content, ics01_submit_to AS submit_to, ics01_related_law AS related_law, ics01_company_id AS company_id

, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) || ' 외 ' || COUNT(sch03_deadline.*) - 1 || '건' END FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') /* 스케줄 (1) / 내부통제-반복 (2) / 내부통제-수시 (3) */ AND ics01_class_tree_id = sch03_info_id AND ics01_company_id = sch03_company_id LIMIT 1 ) AS cycle_name , ( SELECT count(sys11_relate_file.*) || '건' FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys11_file_id = sys10_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = ics01_class_tree_id ) AS file_count , ( SELECT count(*) || '건' FROM ics19_revision_relate_ics WHERE ics19_class_tree_id = ics01_class_tree_id ) AS revision_count
, ( SELECT count(*) || '건' FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id INNER JOIN tdm45_manl_relate_ics ON tdm45_manl_id = tdm43_manl_id WHERE tdm42_company_id IN (1, 28000) /*(연관법령 관리회사 : 한국펀드서비스(KFS)*/ AND f_today() BETWEEN tdm42_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm42_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND tdm45_ics_class_tree_id = ics01_class_tree_id ) AS tdm_count
, NULL::text AS tdm_count

SELECT , COALESCE(ics01_advis_yn,'false') AS advis_yn
FROM ics01_class_tree LEFT OUTER JOIN ics03_company_info ON (ics03_ics_class_tree_id = ics01_class_tree_id AND ics03_company_id = #{companyId}) WHERE ics01_class_tree_id IN () AND ics01_type_cd = #{typeCode} AND coalesce(ics01_public_type,'0') like #{publicType} AND ( ( #{advisYn} = true AND coalesce(coalesce(ics03_advis_yn, ics01_advis_yn),'false') = 'true' ) OR ( #{advisYn} != true ) )
AND CONCAT(ics01_class_tree_cd, ics01_class_tree_nm) LIKE #{searchText}
ORDER BY ics01_class_tree_cd
mapper.sql: , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) || ' 외 ' || COUNT(sch03_deadline.*) - 1 || '건' END FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') /* 스케줄 (1) / 내부통제-반복 (2) / 내부통제-수시 (3) */ AND ics01_class_tree_id = sch03_info_id AND ics01_company_id = sch03_company_id LIMIT 1 ) AS cycle_name

AND ics01_type_cd = #{typeCode} AND COALESCE(ics03_except_yn, 'false') != 'true'
AND REPLACE(UPPER(CONCAT(ics01_class_tree_cd, ics01_class_tree_nm)), ' ', '') LIKE REPLACE(UPPER(#{lawSearch}), ' ', '') AND REPLACE(UPPER(ics01_related_law), ' ', '') LIKE REPLACE(UPPER(#{statuteSearch}), ' ', '')
AND REPLACE(UPPER(CONCAT(ics01_class_tree_cd, ics01_class_tree_nm, ics01_content)), ' ', '') LIKE REPLACE(UPPER(#{lawSearch}), ' ', '') AND REPLACE(UPPER(CONCAT(ics01_related_law, ics01_content)), ' ', '') LIKE REPLACE(UPPER(#{statuteSearch}), ' ', '')
AND ics01_class_tree_id IN ()

SELECT a.ics01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(a.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name, c.sch03_deadline_id AS deadline_id, f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name, f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name FROM ics01_class_tree a LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON (c.sch03_info_id = a.ics01_class_tree_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') AND /* 스케줄 (1) / 내부통제-반복 (2) / 내부통제-수시 (3) */ c.sch03_company_id = a.ics01_company_id ) WHERE a.ics01_class_tree_id IN #{id}
